description: Read, index, pack and file your documents from the terminal. Local file toolkit for pdf, docx/odt/epub/rtf, xlsx, md/html/txt, json/xml/csv and images: convert, OCR, inspect, index, search, pack for LLM context, catalog, watch — with an MCP server and a Claude Code plugin marketplace.
rules: Every data-producing command accepts --json; exit codes are stable (0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage, 3 missing optional binary, 4 bad input, 5 empty result) — branch on the code, not on the message.
Run `carrel doctor` (or `carrel doctor --json`) before relying on a capability: optional binaries are detected at runtime and a missing one exits 3 with an install hint for that platform.

Use `carrel pack --query` for bounded LLM context rather than packing a whole tree; FTS5 AND-s the query terms, and under --json a pack that matched nothing exits 5 instead of returning an empty document.
`carrel mcp` is confined to the directory it was started in — every tool path, client-supplied root and carrel:// URI outside it is refused — unless it was started with --allow-outside-root.
`rename`, `organize`, `intake` and `dedupe` dry-run by default and refuse to move files git is tracking; --apply performs the move and --allow-tracked overrides the guard.
